name: hippo
description: Your coding agents learn while you sleep. hippo indexes what your agents did on this machine, keeps your notes true overnight with a second model checking every change, and starts each new session with the notes its task needs. This plugin adds the $hippo skill: set hippo up, ask what an earlier session found, brief a new task, and go through the Inbox.

interface.shortDescription: Your coding agents learn while you sleep
interface.longDescription: hippo reads the sessions your coding agents leave on this machine (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more) and indexes them locally. At night a model reads the day and drafts fixes to your notes and rules from what you corrected; a second model checks each one before it is applied, and every change has a receipt you can undo. Each new Codex session starts with the notes its task needs. The $hippo skill sets it up for this project, answers "has an agent already solved this?" from past sessions, writes a start brief for a new task, and walks you through the rules waiting in the Inbox.
defaultPrompt: Set up hippo for this project
Has any agent already solved the flaky upload test?
What's waiting in my hippo Inbox?
